fusions.name: Night Sip
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 4 dark damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Many Small Mouths
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bats at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 shadow damage. 20% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Dark Roost
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds and restores 10 health. While veiled, enemies notice you 60% later and you move 10% faster. The veil breaks the moment you attack.
When your health falls below half, you heal for 25% of all damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds. You gain 6% dodge chance.
fusions.name: Thirst at Dusk
